turns.question: It's 12 October 2026. What are our sales in Germany so far this month?
turns.answer: "Sales" can mean revenue or net revenue, so both figures for Germany (customer country DE) from 1 to 12 October 2026 are below: revenue is 533.75 EUR (gross, non-cancelled orders) and net revenue is 494.00 EUR (revenue minus partner returns). Fresh: returns.silver is ready up to 2026-10-03T00:00Z. Late: sales.silver is ready only up to 2026-10-03T00:00Z, older than its 36 h deadline.
